title: Host policy (policy/v1)
description: The closed declarative host-policy format chosen by ADR-0017 (master plan 25 item 8). A policy/v1 document is the application-package policy of M1-01 (role_grants, risk_overrides, field_projection, exactly the same shapes) plus one optional section, rules: conditional rules over roles, token capability scopes, tenant, workspace and the field values of a call. An M1-01 policy with no rules and no format key is a valid policy/v1 document. The format can only narrow or raise, by grammar: the one place that grants anything is role_grants, a rule can only deny, raise the risk level or hide fields, and no operator lowers a risk level or a platform floor, so the host cannot widen what the platform denied or lower what the platform requires. There are no expressions, no regular expressions, no wildcards, no arithmetic and no references; evaluation cost is bounded by the size of the document. The format is authored as YAML in policies/*.yaml and validated here in its parsed JSON form; internal/policy parses it independently, strictly, and a test keeps the two in agreement.

format.description: The policy format and its major version. Optional because the only defined format is policy/v1 and an M1-01 policy carries no format key; a loader that sees any other value refuses the document. A later format (for example cedar/v1, ADR-0017) is a different document kind selected by this key, not an extension of this one.

policy_id.description: The policy ID, unique in the package.

description.description: Optional note on what the policy is for.

role_grants.description: Which roles may use which capabilities. The only place a capability is granted. Same shape and meaning as the application-package policy.

risk_overrides.description: Unconditional raises of a capability's risk level. May be empty. Same shape and meaning as the application-package policy.

field_projection.description: Which fields of a capability the model may see. May be empty. Same shape and meaning as the application-package policy.

rules.description: Conditional rules. Optional; absent means none. Every rule narrows or raises and none grants: when its condition holds, the rule denies the capability, raises its risk level to at least a value, or hides fields from the model. Rule IDs are unique across the package. An unconditional rule is not expressible here on purpose: it is a role grant that is left out, a risk override or a field projection.

id.description: The rule ID, unique in the package. It appears in the audit record of every decision the rule influenced.

capabilities.description: The capabilities the rule applies to. Exact IDs from the manifest; wildcards do not exist. At least one.

when.description: The condition. Every key present must hold (logical AND). At least one key.

then.description: What the rule does when the condition holds: deny, or raise the risk level and hide fields.

reason.description: Why the host wants this, for the audit trail.

roles.description: Condition on the roles of the verified context.

scopes.description: Condition on the capability scopes of the context token (capability IDs, exact match).

tenants.description: Condition on the tenant ID of the verified context.

workspaces.description: Condition on the workspace ID of the verified context.

fields.description: Conditions on the field values of the call, keyed by capability field name. Evaluated when a call is prepared or committed, when the values are known; at exposure no values exist (see ADR-0017). A comparison on a value that is absent or of the wrong type is indeterminate and counts as a match, so a rule never silently fails to narrow; add present: true to a predicate to say that it applies only when the field is there.

setCondition.description: Tests a set of values the context has several of. any: at least one listed value is present. all: every listed value is present. none: no listed value is present.

valueCondition.description: Tests a value the context has exactly one of. in: the value is listed. not_in: the value is not listed.

scalar.description: A comparison value: a string of at most 256 characters, a number or a boolean. Never null, an array or an object.

fieldPredicate.description: Operators on one field, all of which must hold (logical AND), so a range is gte plus lt. eq and ne compare a string, number or boolean for equality; in and not_in test membership of a list; gt, gte, lt and lte compare numbers; present tests only whether the field has a value.

deny.description: Deny the capability. Takes precedence over every other outcome and cannot be combined with the other effects.

risk_min.description: Raise the risk level of the capability to at least this value. The effective level is the highest of the declared level, the platform floor of the effect class, every risk override and every matching risk_min; no value here can lower anything. 1 to 3: a raise to 0 raises nothing and is not accepted.

hide_fields.description: Fields the model must not see or propose when the rule applies. At least one.
